mapper.insert: insert into payment_order ( id, app_id, user_email, plan_id, subject, amount_fen, quota, status, pay_url, qr_code_url, trade_no, buyer_id, notify_payload, expires_at, paid_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{appId}, #{userEmail}, #{planId}, #{subject}, #{amountFen}, #{quota}, #{status}, #{payUrl}, #{qrCodeUrl}, #{tradeNo}, #{buyerId}, #{notifyPayload}, #{expiresAt}, #{paidAt}, 0, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select id, app_id, user_email, plan_id, subject, amount_fen, quota, status, pay_url, qr_code_url, trade_no, buyer_id, notify_payload, expires_at, paid_at, version, created_at, updated_at from payment_order where id = #{id} limit 1
mapper.update: update payment_order set status = #{status}, trade_no = #{tradeNo}, buyer_id = #{buyerId}, notify_payload = #{notifyPayload}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, updated_at = now(), version = version + 1 where id = #{id}
